plan: To prioritize capital preservation, we will sell all leveraged ETFs, SOXL and SPAL, to zero.
SPY will be trimmed to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the single-name mandate.
QQQ will be sold entirely due to its downtrend and sell signal.
QQQI will be trimmed to 15%, favoring income while managing overall size.
SMH will be trimmed to 5% to reduce semiconductor concentration.
conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% per month. It significantly de-risks the portfolio by cutting leverage and reducing concentration. Expect lower drawdowns but also more modest growth potential.

plan: For a balanced approach, we will trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 1%, reducing leveraged ETF exposure.
SPY will be trimmed to 25% to address concentration and meet the mandate.
We will buy RGTI at 4% of the book, leveraging a strong scanner setup.
QQQ will be sold entirely due to its downtrend and sell signal.
QQQI will be trimmed to 10% to balance income with growth.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while introducing a high-quality new long setup. Expect moderate drawdowns and growth potential.

plan: For aggressive growth, we will add to SOXL and SPAL, targeting 6% each, leaning into leveraged ETFs.
RGTI will be bought at 6% of the book, concentrating in a high-scoring scanner setup.
SPY will be trimmed to 25% to meet the single-name mandate.
QQQ will be sold entirely due to its downtrend and sell signal.
QQQI will be trimmed to 5% to reduce income exposure and free capital for growth.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% per month by stretching growth and using leverage. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware this mode carries substantially higher drawdown risk and leveraged ETFs experience daily decay and rebalancing, which can lead to rapid losses if stops are not strictly adhered to.

plan: To prioritize income, we will sell all leveraged ETFs, SOXL and SPAL, to zero.
QQQI will be significantly increased to 30% of the book to boost monthly distributions.
SPY will be trimmed to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
QQQ will be sold entirely due to its downtrend and sell signal.
SMH will be trimmed to 5% to reduce high-beta exposure.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1% per month by rotating into income-generating ETFs. It cuts leverage and high-beta names to near zero, prioritizing low drawdown and reliable distributions. Remember, distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is not a savings account.
